The Radium Engineering fuel rails for the Nissan R35 GT-R VR38DETT are machined from 6061 aluminium and black anodised for compatibility with popular fuel types including E85. Their large internal bore supports high power requirements, and each rail has four 8AN ORB ports (two end, two top) for eight ports in total.
